product_overview: PR-OS is a municipal public relations operations hub for managing event schedules, staff assignments, office monitor displays, and management reporting. It centralizes event lifecycle workflows from creation through completion while providing mobile task acknowledgment and administrative settings.
core_goals: View an up-to-date overview of public relations event activity
Browse and filter scheduled events in table or calendar formats
Create, edit, duplicate, publish, complete, and cancel PR events
Assign staff to events and review schedule conflicts before finalizing changes
Display safe event information on office monitors
Generate workload reports and export them for management review
Allow assigned staff to acknowledge tasks from a mobile-friendly view
Maintain staff, user, and reference data in system settings

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Provides an executive summary of PR operations with key metrics, smart insights, and quick navigation to core workflows.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View KPI summary cards and smart analytics -> Open schedule, event creation, or reports from quick actions

features.name: Schedule & Calendar View
features.description: Lets users inspect PR events in table, month, or week formats and narrow results using filters.
user_flows: Navigate to /schedule -> Switch between table, month calendar, and week calendar -> Filter events by status, department, date range, or keyword -> Select an event to open its detail view

features.name: Event Creation & Management
features.description: Supports the full lifecycle of PR events, including creating, editing, duplicating, publishing, completing, and canceling events with staff assignments and conflict checks.
user_flows: Navigate to /events/new -> Fill in event details -> Assign staff members and roles -> Review the event summary -> Create the event
Navigate to /events/new -> Start from an existing event clone -> Adjust the copied details -> Create the duplicated event
Navigate to a specific event detail page from the schedule or event list -> Review event information and assigned staff -> Check for schedule conflicts -> Edit the event details -> Save changes
Navigate to a specific event detail page from the schedule or event list -> Mark the event as published or completed
Navigate to a specific event detail page from the schedule or event list -> Choose to cancel the event -> Provide a cancellation reason -> Confirm the cancellation

features.name: Public Office Monitor
features.description: Displays monitor-safe event information in a large, high-contrast format for office signage, with an optional retro broadcast style.
user_flows: Navigate to /monitor -> View today’s and upcoming events in a large-font signage layout
Navigate to /monitor?classic=1 -> View the same event schedule in retro TV mode

features.name: Management Reports & Export
features.description: Shows workload and assignment reporting for management, with options to export or print the results.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Set a date range -> Review workload statistics and unacknowledged assignments -> Download the report as a multi-sheet Excel file
Navigate to /reports -> Set a date range -> Review report results -> Open the print-ready report view

features.name: Mobile Assignee Tasks
features.description: Provides a mobile-friendly task list for assigned staff to review their PR jobs and acknowledge assignments.
user_flows: Navigate to /mobile/my-tasks -> Review assigned PR jobs and tasks -> Acknowledge an assignment

features.name: System Settings
features.description: Allows administrators to manage staff master data, user accounts, and municipal reference data.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Review and manage staff records, user accounts, and reference data

routes.description: Dashboard overview with KPIs, smart summary, and recent PR events

Mobile-optimized view for assignees to see tasks and acknowledge assignments
Office digital signage monitor view (table or retro TV mode)

System administration for staff, user accounts, and master data
